item.title: Cavan named the county with the lowest 12 pubs completion rate
item.description: A nationwide study indicates that Cavan and Monaghan are among the hardest places in Ireland to complete the 12 Pubs of Christmas. The research shows Cavan has the lowest completion rate in the country, with just a 5%chance of reaching the twelfth pub Monaghan is not far behind, with only about eight percent expected to finish the full route. item.title: Planning permission approved for 22 apartments in Cavan
item.description: Planning permission has been approved for 22 apartments in Cavan. The green light has been given by Cavan County Council for the own door residential units being built in two 2-storey blocks. The 22 units will comprise of six 2-bed apartments on ground floor level and 6 duplex units in Block A. Advertisement While in Block B will be made up of five 2-bed apartments on the ground floor and five one-bed duplex units above those. item.title: SVP say requests for help this year has been much higher than in 2024
item.description: The Society of Saint Vincent de Paul say requests for help this year has been much higher than in 2024. The charity says they have seen rising calls from people wondering how they will put food on the table, keep homes warm, and afford toys. SVP National President Teresa Ryan who is a native of Ballybay says this Christmas, too many parents are wondering how they'll manage the basics and what 2026 will look for them. item.title: Local trainer advises people to stay active over Christmas
item.description: A local personal trainer is advising the public to try and stay active over the Christmas period. Darragh 'Dutchy' Holland is the owner of Dutchy's Fitness in Cavan Town. He has advised that the period around Christmas should be treated as a "maintenance phase." Advertisement The trainer believes that people should focus on doing some movement, and not trying to do burst themselves to hit big goals. item.title: Man arrested over serious assault in Fermanagh
item.description: Police in the north have made an arrest following a serious assault in Enniskillen. It happened just after midnight, on East Bridge Street, where a man was punched in the head. He was taken to hospital, where he’s being treated for serious but non-life-threatening injuries. item.title: New water feature planned for Carrickmacrosss
item.description: A local councillor has welcomed funding allocated to Carrickmacross under the nationwide Town and Village Renewal scheme. Funding of €500,000 was awarded towards streetscape and amenity enhancements to the main street, including the enhancement of lighting to historic landmark buildings and the provision of a public water feature at the Market Square.
